Rules

Validation Rules

Industrial safety checks before invoice dispatch.

  • Working days: must be between 20 and 26 for June 2026.
  • Employee roster: employee must exist and match the client roster.
  • CTC: salary components must equal total CTC.
  • Overtime: cannot exceed 50 hours per month.
  • Future dates: invalid for invoice generation.
  • Reimbursements: reason and amount required; only allowed categories are approved.
  • Net pay: gross + OT + reimbursements - deductions.
